items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: We might stand up and be blowing away. Son was sit right there.

ctx.x: He was a man. He never stayed up like me.

He was a man. He was a man. He never stayed up like me. We might stand up and be blowing away. Son was sit right there. And before you know it, the musicians don't stop making them stand around. People stop dancing. You sit down there and, oh, man, boy.
He was a piano player, too. He was a piano player, too.
